# Orphion Pharma

> Dubai-headquartered Orphion Pharma connects innovative and rare disease medicines with patients in Türkiye through named patient access, institutional supply, market access, regulatory support and local representation.

Headquarters: Meydan Grandstand, 6th Floor, Meydan Road, Nad Al Sheba, Dubai, U.A.E.
Offices: Headquarters – Dubai (Dubai, U.A.E.); Türkiye Liaison Office (Çankaya / Ankara, Türkiye); US Outreach Office (United States).
Chairman & Managing Partner: Fevzi Aydın.

## Capabilities

- Named Patient Access: Bringing innovative medicines not yet licensed in Türkiye to individual patients through the named patient pathway.
- Government & Institutional Supply: Compliant supply to public institutions, hospitals and tenders, backed by reliable logistics.
- Market Access & Reimbursement: Türkiye-specific strategy for pricing, reimbursement and sustainable patient access.
- Regulatory Pathway Support: Guidance through the Turkish regulatory pathway, from documentation to approval.
- Exclusive Distribution & Local Representation: Acting as the manufacturer's committed local partner and representative in Türkiye.
- Specialty & Rare Disease Medicines: A focus on specialty and orphan therapies, where access matters most.
- Direct Manufacturer-to-Patient Access: Access solutions connecting manufacturers directly with patients through compliant channels.
